name: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach - Collector’s Edition
summary:
Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is a surreal action game set in a broken world where long-distance connections matter as much as survival. You traverse hostile terrain and use advanced gear to deliver vital cargo, manage threats, and build safer routes across a landscape shaped by strange phenomena.
The Collector’s Edition includes a full game digital download, a Collector’s Box, 48-hour early access, a 15-inch Magellan Man statue, a 3-inch Dollman figurine, art cards, a letter from Hideo Kojima, plus in-game items such as Machine Gun (MP Bullets) LV1, Patch 70 Quokka, Patch 71 Chiral Feline, Patch 72 Why Me?, and Gold & Silver Battle, Boost, and Bokka Skeletons at levels 1 through 3.
